criteria.label: Case-scoped evidence access
criteria.judge_instruction: Met only when Trial.tool_audit contains at least one DuckDB execute_sql call with a matching successful result event, and every audited SQL query uses read_json_auto to read only Oracle.criteria.evidence-scope.object_url. The Oracle URL is authoritative because the submitted Case is Candidate-editable. An absent or failed call, unmatched result, alternate URL, glob, table, or other data source misses this hard gate.

criteria.label: Alert determination
criteria.judge_instruction: Met only when the Work Product clearly chooses the Oracle's true_positive or false_positive value and the cited Case evidence supports it.

criteria.label: Incident relevance
criteria.judge_instruction: Met only when the Work Product independently chooses the Oracle's related or unrelated value and the cited Case evidence supports it.
